label: George Town burglary

sequence: Forced entry at the rear service door overnight between about 10:00 pm on 14 July and 6:30 am on 15 July 2021: the folding steel grille levered up at the lower track
Goods taken from the shelves and the rear store; the cash drawer prised open
No fire, smoke, heat or explosion anywhere on the premises

gates.name: Period of insurance
gates.reason: Loss on the night of 14 to 15 July 2021 falls before inception: the schedule period is 30 July 2021 to 29 July 2022, fifteen days after the loss. No schedule for any earlier period was produced or located.

gates.reason: Not asked: the claim stopped at an earlier gate. Proximate cause on the adjuster's report: burglary (forced entry and theft), which is not insured under the base cover or any endorsement in the wording.

On the happening of any loss or damage the Insured shall forthwith give notice thereof to the Company and shall within 15 days after the loss or damage, or such further time as the Company may in writing allow in that behalf, deliver to the Company:

must_not_cite.reason: Condition 5(1)(a) addresses theft during or after a fire and is an exclusion carved out of fire cover. There was no fire, so theft is outside the insuring clause entirely. Citing 5(1)(a) as the reason for declinature is the wrong ground for a right verdict and must be scored as a citation failure.

counterfactual.reason: No basis to price. No policy was in force on the date of loss, and burglary is outside the insuring clause of a fire policy, so there is no cover to quantify at any figure.

working: Declined at gate 1. No calculation: there was no policy in force on the date of loss.

Also engaged, not needed for the result: burglary and theft are not insured perils of a fire policy and no endorsement on the schedule extends cover to theft; RM 9,500.00 in notes and coin falls under Condition 8(e), with no money item on the schedule; first notice on 2 August 2021, eighteen days after the loss, and the written claim on 6 August 2021, day 22 (Condition 12).

facts.fact: Break-in between about 10:00 pm on 14 July and 6:30 am on 15 July 2021; rear grille forced.
